storyCards.headline: Famous Last Words: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
My Chemical Romance's "Famous Last Words" reached #88 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Famous Last Words" is a song by the American rock band My Chemical Romance from their third studio album, The Black Parade (2006).

The song peaked at #88 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.

Famous Last Words was released in 2007.
